scope: A two-qubit exact matrix model over the Gaussian rationals, with an interacting Hamiltonian, density states, Born probabilities, Heisenberg derivation, and a finite Krein companion.

mathematical_base.carrier: M_4(Q(i)) represented by finite labelled arrays
mathematical_base.sufficiency_claim: The displayed witness can be checked in primitive-recursive arithmetic and interpreted in ZF without invoking a choice function; this is a sufficiency result for this named finite object, not a weakest-base reversal.

physical_data.dynamics: delta(A) = i[H,A], with the t=pi/4 density update represented exactly over Q(i)
physical_data.interaction_witness: The evolved pure state has one-qubit reduced density I/2, whereas the input |++> is a product state.
physical_data.krein_companion: J=diag(1,1,-1,-1), H^sharp=H, and the scaled finite-time evolution satisfies U^sharp U=2I before the common sqrt(2) normalization.

independent_checker.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction pairs only; no float, complex, trigonometric, numerical linear algebra, or random input
checks: normalization and idempotence of exact density matrices
maximally mixed reduced density after interaction
finite Krein symmetry, J-self-adjointness, and scaled J-unitarity

cube_support.boundary: The interaction part supports only finite interaction algebra and exact state evolution. It does not support renormalization, counterterm classification, anomaly cancellation, or QME restoration, so the combined obligation label must retain that qualification.

does_not_establish: a weakest logical or set-theoretic base
that PRA, ZF without Choice, Bishop constructivism, and finitism are equivalent regimes
an infinite-dimensional Hilbert, Krein, or C*-completion
a continuum field theory or controlled continuum limit
renormalization or restoration of the quantum master equation
a physical selection principle for the displayed states
a Lorentzian propagator, Hadamard state, or causal quantum theory
